name: coaching-benchmark
description: ICOS Coaching Benchmark (Tier 2 — Coaching Quality — of the ICOS Evaluation System). The ground-truth corpus and scoring rubric a future structured coach is measured on: seeded from REAL historical failures, not synthetic adversarial cases. Standalone, sibling to evidence-benchmark. Contains NO coach implementation and modifies no other package. Scoring is manual/founder-judgment in this build; the report format is stable so scores stay comparable as the corpus grows.
